decisions.statement: The lualib pages say which feature a source file's name reaches.
The lualib pages say the name each source file's export is emitted under.
The identifier a page's code exports reaches the emitted Lua nowhere.
A reference to an export is printed under the name the page states.
A code file exporting more than one name keeps the names its own code exports.
An import of another source file names that file's feature as a dependency.
An import of a file the pages replace resolves to the file taken instead.
The lualib sources sit beside the compiler rather than among its modules.

definition: the lualib TypeScript sources built into per-feature Lua code and a bundle
